E) FLIGHTS WILL TAKE PLACE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR AS DESCRIBED BELOW:
1.- AREA: 353100N 0242600E - 353100N 0242800E - 353200N 0242800E -
353200N 0243800E - 352500N 0243800E - 352700N 0242600E - 353100N
0242600E. SOUDA MTMA AFFECTED.
- REMARK: FORACS
2.- PROCEDURES FOR PARTICIPATING ACFT:
2.1.- PARTICIPATING ACFT WILL FLY VFR IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO RULES
AND PROCEDURES AS AMPLIFIED IN AIP-GREECE, ENR 1.2.
2.2.- PARTICIPATING ACFT WILL SUBMIT FLIGHT PLANS, WILL NOT ENTER
CONTROLLED AIRSPACE UNLESS PRIOR PERMISSION HAS BEEN OBTAINED BY
APPROPRIATE ATC UNIT AND WILL BE OPERATING THE TRANSPONDER ON A/3
MODE, DISCRETE CODE AND MODE C.
3.- PROCEDURES FOR NON PARTICIPATING AIRCRAFT:
3.1.- IN THE INTEREST OF SAFETY DURING THE ACCURACY CHECK, NON
PARTICIPATING AIRCRAFT ARE STRONGLY ADVISED NOT TO FLY WITHIN THE
AREA DESIGNATED IN PARA (1) ABOVE.
3.2.- ACFT UNABLE TO AVOID THE AREA WILL BE AUTHORIZED TO ENTER THIS
AREA AFTER SPECIAL PERMISSION BY APPROPRIATE
ATC UNIT.
F) SFC G) 2500FT AMSL
